caption: The drawing depicts a sculpted figure of a standing woman viewed in profile, facing left. The figure has curly hair pulled back and is attired in a long-sleeved bodice and a full skirt with decorative, floral-like embroidery near the hem. Her left arm is relaxed at her side, while her right hand gathers the folds of her skirt. The woman's foot rests on an ornately carved, scroll-shaped base adorned with leaf and swirl motifs. The entire figure is shaded in tones of brown, beige, and light sepia, giving it a monochromatic and wooden appearance. The background is blank and light in color, bringing full attention to the figure and its carved base.
title: Figurehead: Woman
